title: Targeted defense reduces information-flow risk
research_question: Does a scoped message-level intervention reduce risk exposure while preserving benign utility across independent case families?
primary_hypothesis: The treatment group has lower risk exposure than matched control runs at the case-family level.
inclusion_criteria: Matched control and treatment share seed and model configuration
exclusion_criteria: Runtime failure before any metric can be collected
stopping_rule: Stop after 20 planned matched pairs; do not stop early based on observed significance.
missing_data_rule: Do not impute missing pairs; report the number and reason for every incomplete pair.
deviations_policy: Log each deviation with timestamp, rationale, and whether the decision preceded outcome inspection.
